answer: A mirrored reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks in an agent economy. Every agent's completed work is mirrored to several independent verifier nodes, so a new identity starts with no history and must earn trust task by task. A raven sentinel, an independent auditor agent, randomly re-checks a sample of each agent's past work; fakes are caught because forging a consistent history across mirrors costs more than the reward. Like a sable coat that cannot be dyed overnight, reputation here is built slowly and lost instantly, so spinning up thousands of fake identities buys nothing.
